Scope of Work: Onsite Calibration of All telemetric DWFMs within first 30 days of the a ward of work along with calibration certificate Comprehensive AMC for the 28 nos. flow meters for a period of 2 year from the date of award of work Hassle free maintaining of dedicated online web server and continuou s online availability of DWFM data on the server throughout the contra ct period Choice of SIM brands depending upon the network connectivity availa ble at the site,shall be in the scope of the bidder. Project Proponent sh all not provide any sim for any instrument Recharge of all sims installed in the all DWFMs during the contract pe riod In case of any instrument defect/inbuilt problem of DWFMs/network c onnectivity/battery issue/ non transferring of data to the server, the b idder shall have to repair the instrument within 72 Hrs by either physi cally attending the site or virtually/ telephonic conversation. If there is any problem with the instrument which cannot be rectified by our employee or worker by telephonic support of yours, then techn ical executives/ service engineer has to attend/visit the site physically upon communication within 7 days of such communication. In case th e problem is not rectified, bidder must provide like replacement for th e defective DWFM One routine visit of technical executives/ service engineer at the time of calibration and at an interval of six month and additional emergenc y visit as per the requirement In case of penalty imposition by CGWA due to defective service by the bidder, WCL shall reserve the right to recover such penalty from the b ills of the successful bidder. Technical justification : The DWFMs installed in the mines of Chandrapur Are a are of Dhara Parvah make. The DWFM are telemetry enabled and telemetry li nk has been communicated to Central Groundwater Authority for access and ve rification of dewatering data. Hence, the calibration, telemetry data server are t o be continually maintained to avoid imposition of penalty by CGWA. Therefore, the OEM or for Stauatory Compliance may be invited to participate in the tende r to ensure continued device functionng and server data storage. Note: 1. Work completion period: 2 years from the date of commencement shall be reckoned fr om 10th day of award of work. 2. Inspection, executing & contract controlling authority: Area Nodal Officer (Environme nt) or his representative. 3. Transportation: To and fro transportation cost will be borne by the bidder. 4. While working in mine for handling of works. Bidder should ensure that your workmen shoul

d use the safety appliance like Gumboot / Mining shoes / Helmets/ insulated ladder /Hand Gl oves/ safety belt etc. If applicable 5. Safety of Persons engaged: The contractor shall provide safety equipment to the persons engaged in carrying out the work. The contractor shall be responsible for any accident. WCL will not accept any liability on that account. All safety rules & regulation shall be observed b y the contractor including following provision of works-man compensation Act / any other Ac t / Law / rules prevailing as on date. 6. Electricity will be provided by WCL if required. 7. Guarantee/ Warranty: Bidder should ensure guarantee of the erection, repair, works and supply of material for work undertaken against all manufacturing defects, design, quality of workmanship & materials free of cost for a period of 6 months from the date of installation o r 12 months from date of delivery/ completion of work which is earlier. . 6.
